figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 1
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Overview, phantom/ex vivo labels, supplied-action-window limitation and SRTH FVD/GATC mini-charts. The policy loop is motivational, not evaluated control. Chart values repeat main results.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 2
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Action-to-skeleton predictor, geometry/kinematic paths, full-attention teacher, causal student and training-time distillation. Teacher/student are inference alternatives.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table I
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Seven-metric teacher/student comparisons on SutureBot and SRTH; Predicted versus privileged Oracle separated. Legacy FVD row/column misattributions identified.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 3
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Selected SutureBot/SRTH/Cao outputs; annotated baseline geometry drift, interaction misalignment and artifacts. Qualitative selection, not a human clinical study.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 4
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Cao video-generator transfer ranks across seven metrics. Outer ring is rank one; distances are not raw metric effect sizes.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table II
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Six-metric predicted-skeleton injection ablation; native actions retained in every variant. Combined row repeats Table I Predicted.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 5
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Six successive 12-frame segments on 28 SutureBot validation episodes; teacher/student comparisons, no uncertainty bands. Teacher final-segment TCD exception retained. No numeric points estimated.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table III
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Joint H12 upper panel versus domain-adapted horizon-wise lower panel; three-domain macro-average, 960×540 coordinates. Counts are windows per domain, not the main SutureBot episode counts.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 6
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Caption and supplied upstream visual note describe physical master-device and VR command interfaces. Surrounding extracted labels appear duplicated from Figure 3; original image reinspection queued.

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 7
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Two different supplied command trajectories from the same initial image/skeleton produce different skeleton/video branches. Qualitative functional L3 at system scope; exact generator variant unreported.

scope_choices: This is automated API model review and a skeptical second model pass over supplied text and upstream review notes, not independent human verification or replication.

All nine physical-page text blocks were read. Original page images were not directly supplied to this pass; their nine supplied automated review notes were inspected instead. Direct visual reinspection remains outstanding.
The supplied source hash and local-file availability were not independently recomputed or checked against a filesystem.
Earlier page-review notes contain per-request statements that only subsets of pages were supplied. Those statements describe their earlier scopes, not the current complete nine-page text packet.

The supplied page-7 text extraction duplicates Figure 3-like image labels near Figure 6, whereas the Figure 6 caption and upstream visual note describe master/VR photographs. Original page-image reinspection is needed to resolve this extraction artifact.
The provided ontology excerpt lacks the complete feature catalogue. Feature assertions and the 128-feature coverage assessment were intentionally not created, as requested.
No executable JSON Schema validator, cross-reference checker, graph builder, filesystem write, repository inspection or experiment was run in this response.
Model identities are paper-described configurations, not cryptographically pinned weight artifacts. The domain-adapted H12 row aggregates separate models whose individual identities are unresolved.
Teacher block prediction, student generated-history autoregression and anchored joint skeleton forecasts have different feedback semantics; none is measured physical re-assimilation.
Figure 7 supports qualitative matched alternative-action prediction at system scope, but does not identify the exact generator variant or provide physical ground truth for both branches.
The paper explicitly leaves sustained closed-loop robot control unvalidated. No optimizer, learned decision policy or measured decision/control outcome supports L4.
Causal attention and generated-history masking do not identify causal intervention effects. No clinical treatment-effect estimand, identification study or sensitivity analysis is established.
Environment evidence is preclinical. Actual held-out human clinical data are not reported; episode-disjoint phantom/ex vivo/nonhuman recordings do not establish R2.
Operator/master/VR photographs and qualitative interaction do not establish a defined human study, R4, patient feasibility or clinical utility.
The observed initial structure is supplied from offline SurgPose detections. Skeleton and segmentation metric references depend on external tools whose errors are not quantified here.
H12 joint, H12 adapted and H72 predictors have different training/evaluation protocols. Their results must not be merged into one artifact.
The 732 H72 windows arise from 28 validation episodes and are not independent episode counts.
Disjoint episodes do not establish patient-, operator-, procedure- or site-level independence; complete pretrained-model data overlap is not reported.
The SutureBot main video panel uses 28 eligible validation episodes, not the 146-episode test split. Selection/tuning effects are not quantified.
The explicit SRTH 95-episode, 24-frame statement concerns teacher comparisons; the student sample count and full horizon are not separately established.
Headline FVD uses only the first 16 future frames, not the entire 72-frame SutureBot rollout.
Figure 5 reports segment curves without exact numeric point tables or uncertainty bands. No numeric curve values were estimated.
The teacher's TCD advantage reverses slightly in the last segment; nonmonotonic curves do not prove indefinite stability.
No accepted effective-horizon tolerance or validated prediction/control deadline is reported.
The generator-transfer claim is limited to no video-generator fine-tuning on Cao. The separate H12 predictor benchmark includes Cao; whole-pipeline target-domain independence is not established.
Cao transfer results are reported as ranks; raw effect magnitudes and sample counts are not supplied.
Oracle uses annotated future skeletons and is separately trained. A small metric gap does not establish statistical equivalence or deployable future-input availability.
No repeated-seed uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests are reported for the extracted metric panels.
Stochastic flow/diffusion generation does not establish aleatoric/epistemic separation, calibrated uncertainty or joint trajectory coverage.
Action physical units, reference frames, valid ranges, empirical support and execution-permission semantics remain insufficiently reported.
Projected shaft/wrist/jaw descriptors and tool consistency scores do not validate 3D mechanics, tissue response, force safety or clinical plausibility.
Throughput is measured over ten four-step, 73-frame rollouts. Inference hardware, precision, first-frame latency and closed-loop measurement boundaries are insufficiently reported.
The SurgCast student has slightly lower throughput and higher peak GPU memory than the original student; quality improvement should not be summarized as a demonstrated speedup.

Code, weights, asset licenses, clinical release governance, privacy/security safeguards and operational monitoring are not sufficiently reported. The project examples URL was not accessed and is not a code-release claim.
References on pages 8–9 were read as bibliography entries only. Their systems' planning, physics, clinical evidence or release capabilities were not inherited.
